title: Conjecture that the monochromatic-box matrix is positive semidefinite
statement:
Let $M_r$ be the $2^r \times 2^r$ integer matrix whose rows and columns are indexed by all maps $f_j: [r] \rightarrow [2]$, with $(i,j)$-entry

$$
\binom{|f_i^{-1}(1) \cap f_j^{-1}(1)|}{2} + \binom{|f_i^{-1}(2) \cap f_j^{-1}(2)|}{2}.
$$

**Positive-semidefiniteness conjecture.** $M_r$ is positive semidefinite for $r \geq 3$. The matrix is positive semidefinite in the cases considered computationally, enabling convex programming methods, but the assertion for all $r \geq 3$ remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/0810.3019

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2008).
source_name: Joshua Cooper, Stephen Fenner and Semmy Purewal, “Monochromatic boxes in colored grids”, arXiv:0810.3019 (2008).
